title: Inspect Thompson posterior success estimates
description: You extract stored posterior parameters and display one mean probability per project.

steps.description: You retrieve post from the Thompson result, using None when the key is missing. The plotting branch requires a posterior object.

steps.question: Does mean_p include project rewards and costs?
steps.answer: It uses only alpha/(alpha+beta), so it represents posterior mean success probabilities. This expression contains no R or C terms.

steps.description: You draw one probability bar per project and label the positions with names. The title identifies Thompson posterior means of success rates.
